Messages.Author: Pat Ricochet
Messages.Body:
> The Death pact deck revised, below is the old deck.
> I have no idea if this will work but hell it looks soooo cool!

I might even have the 7 Death Pacts required to build this! Alas, only
one each of the Sargon Fragment and the VeniVidiVici Art S'ang.

> Death Pact, Anyone?
> Concept weenie DOM-nec-Thau Bleed and bruise. An attempt to use not one but
> 3
> considered to be wallpaper cards, Julius, death pact, Patrizia giovanni!!
>
> Crypt: (15 cards)
> 1 Jing Wei
> 1 Brooke
> 1 Ignatius
> 1 Thelonius
> 2 Sarah Cobbler

Why 2 copies? because she has THA? You're still *taking* the damage; I
can't think you'd want to actually take 2 normal damage in addition to
whatever nastiness they do.

> 4 Julius
> 2 Isabel Giovanni

Ah, blessed cheap NEC/DOM. Bet that *does* help this deck. =)

> 3 Patrizia Giovanni

> Library: (80 cards)
> Master (16)
> 1 Anarch Troublemaker

For all the Masters in here, I'd leave this out. Great "in every deck,"
but sounds like hand jam for a trick deck like this.

> 3 Blood Doll
> 1 Creepshow Casino

Another nice FN winner for a deck like this.

> 3 Dominate
> 2 Dreams of the Sphinx
> 1 Giant's Blood

See: Anarch Troublemaker. All the vamps are 5 or less. I'd go for Jake
Washington, really.

> 2 Heidelburg Castle, Germany
> 1 Morgue Hunting Ground
> 2 Path of Bones

For all those Death Pacts and Summon Souls, I'd have to go for the Tower
of London, as practically guaranteed pool gain.

> Minion (64)
> 4 Ambrosius
> 2 Bomb

"Ambrosius gets a bomb" module? And no meat hook? Remember that
Ambrosius can't get Death Pact out of the ash heap, since it's an action
card, not a retainer card. 3 copies seems enough, if you really want him.
Even with the Chainsaw combo.

> 10 Burst of Sunlight
> 2 Call of the Hungry Dead
I'd go for 4 copies. Just too damn good.

> 7 Death Pact
> 6 Deflection
> 8 Govern the Unaligned

Well, people WILL stop blocking you, so 2 Threats, 2 Conditioning, and 2
Forshadowing Destructions will be good so the bleeds still hurt when they
stop blocking.

> 1 Guiseppe, Gravedigger
> 1 Leonardo, Mortician
> 2 Magic of the Smith
> 2 Sargon Fragment, the
> 4 Scouting Mission
> 5 Spectral Divination
> 4 Summon Soul
> 4 Talbot's Chainsaw

No, really. You CAN make a Giovanni deck, even a goofy one, without the
Ambrosius/Talbot's combo.
However, I DO have to admit that having 2 Death Pacts on Amby, so you
have to do 4 agg just to hurt him (preventing one with the Chainsaw), is
pretty damn effective, not to mention funny. =)

> 2 Veneriforum Artum Sanguis

Funny that both new "get ability at superior items" are perfect for this
deck. =)

Like the original version, I'd have 5 Wakes, though.

> Cool huh?
+3 fun!

--
Pat Ricochet
Soul Jar'rn Fool of Atlanta

> Wouldn’t Ex Nihilo go well with a Death Pact?

Well, not if you're playing Weather Control (the Death Pact isn't a
wraith immune to non-agg, though it really should be =). However the
Spiritual Protector becomes actually useful, since you can Weather Control,
etc. and still keep him. (And now that Charisma is out there to offset the
cost...)
In the grand scheme of things, a quantity of Leather Jackets might be
better than the same number of Death Pacts.

> Thanks Pat. I forgot a couple of cards due to cutting and pasting the
> original deck and filling them in. Here's the version I will be
> tweaking.
>

Ahhhh... I really need to actually build this deck and play it. Each
time you explain a bit more (usually correcting me =), the more I see how
well it all fits together.

> The only problem I have with this version is the fact that it has 90
> cards now. And I would like this to go around 70-75 cards. Any
> suggestions??

70-75? Tough. Too many moving parts, I think. But, I'll go for 80. =)

> Crypt: (14 cards)
> 1 Jing Wei
> 1 Brooke
> 1 Ignatius
> 1 Thelonius
> 1 Sarah Cobbler
> 4 Julius
> 2 Isabel Giovanni
> 3 Patrizia Giovanni
>
> Library: (90 cards)
> Master (16)
> 3 Blood Doll
> 1 Creepshow Casino
> 3 Dominate

Is the plan to Crypt Machine out the warlocks with these? Govern and
Deflection are pretty good at inferior, and you don't have *enough* Dominate
skill cards to reliably get the Machine going. I'd drop one of these. (-1
card)

> 2 Dreams of the Sphinx

Cardcycling GOOD. But this isn't *quite* enough.

> 2 Heidelburg Castle, Germany
> 1 Inbase Discotheque

This is fluff, really. What you NEED is a Barrens and/or Fraggy.

> 1 Morgue Hunting Ground
> 2 Path of Bones

Really, you've not got that many cards that need this. Just for deck
size and hand jam, I'd have only one copy, or not even bother. I know, it's
hard to resist, but with only 2 copies, you might as well not count on it,
and then maybe just drop them. (-2 cards)

> 1 Tower of London
>
> Minion (74)
> 2 Ambrosius

> 2 Sargon Fragment, the

> 2 Talbot's Chainsaw
> 2 Veneriforum Artum Sanguis

All unique cards. You could drop 1 of each, but then you wouldn't see
them. And if that Magic of the Smith gets blocked, you can neither Magic of
the Smith nor Grasp the Ghostly it back, so you need 2 copies (Of course,
being able to Summon Soul and then MagicOTS is +2 fun!), BUT you've got 4
discards spoken for, there. 12 turn games and all, you need a Barrens for
the extra discards.

> 2 Bomb
> 9 Burst of Sunlight
> 2 Conditioning
> 4 Call for the Hungry Dead
> 7 Death Pact
> 6 Deflection
> 6 Fake Out
> 4 Foreshadowing Destruction
> 8 Govern the Unaligned
> 1 Guiseppe, Gravedigger
> 1 Leonardo, Mortician
> 2 Magic of the Smith

> 2 Scouting Mission
> 4 Spectral Divination
> 4 Summon Soul

> 4 Wake with Evening's Freshness

Some of these cards you've got a lot of, and may or may not need so
many. Take out 1 Death Pact, 1 Deflection, 2 Fake Out, 1 Foreshadowing, 2
Burst of Sunlight, 1 Call of the Hungry Telemarketers, 1 Spectral
Divination, 1 Deflection to remove 10 cards. Add 3 more Summon Soul for a
total of 7 so you can *recycle* the cards that you DO need. (-7 cards)

And that's down to a slimmer 80 cards with only 13 Masters, and with 7
Summon Soul for "90 card potential." =)
